scope: offline adoption and authenticated-owner lookup plumbing; no strategy or policy threshold change

runs.command: python -m unittest test_boss_adoption test_boss_owner_lookup test_boss_batch test_boss_cached
runs.errorsExplained: Only two new adoption fixtures incorrectly placed their source plan outside mandatory build/cg-boss. They were rejected by the intended production guard. Fixture location was corrected; no production change was needed.

runs.note: All new tests rerun after fixture correction. Same final production source as legacy regression run.

coverage: Original first loss retained exactly once; only39 subsequent plays sent for the40-game fixed sample.
Original intent, play response and canonical files remain byte-identical in both source and adopted copies.
Wrong or tampered source-plan, copied-file, request, slot, seed, game, source and plan pins are rejected.
Deleting an adopted intent cannot cause a replacement play. Other original played slots cannot be omitted.
Standard boss_cached control snapshot accepts the completed adopted control, retains its loss and revalidates original provenance after tampering.
Owner lookup changes only the canonical read second argument and preserves exact play object, code, options, timeout and input list.
Wrong owner, bootstrap hash, session handle, session cookie, puzzle type and missing/changed source backup fail offline.
Both batch and cached entry points persist a write-once owner binding with source pins. Transport is restored after failure.

actualPrivateBootstrapValidation.operation: load_session then validate_owner only; no network
